style: Scrapbook / zine analogue collage. A crumpled paper ball unfurls into a flat torn-paper scrap carrying the title. Heavy condensed headline against a light lowercase subtitle, washi tape, highlighter swipe, biro doodle. Reference-implementation rebuild of the 'Unusual Paper Titles' Premiere .mogrt; see ~/.claude/styles/hyperframes/torn-paper-title.md.
font: Anton (headline) + Exo 2 (subtitle), self-hosted woff2 in assets/fonts/

customize.note: Hand-authored. No catalog block covers a 3D paper unfurl; the closest caption-* blocks are flat text reveals and would have to be torn apart to fit.

scenes.motion: near-static breath (slight rotate + drift), never frozen
reverse crumple back to a ball, ~3x faster than the entrance

technique.approach: 18 vertical slices of one artwork, each slice a 3D-transformed strip inside a shared perspective. Each strip holds a full copy of the artwork offset by -i*stripWidth and cropped by overflow:hidden, so the composed title deforms piecewise with the paper as the strips unfold. Route 3 of the three documented rebuild routes.
technique.fidelity_note: Approximates the original, which displacement-maps the text onto pre-rendered 3D paper-unfold footage. Piecewise strip deformation reads convincingly in motion but is not true surface displacement. Route 2 (Three.js vertex displacement) would match more closely at much higher cost.
technique.determinism: Torn silhouette, crumple creases, doodle path and the per-strip crumple jitter are all generated at load from a fixed-seed mulberry32 PRNG. No render-time clocks, no unseeded randomness, no network.
technique.alpha_overlay: Hide or delete the #bg clip and render with --format webm (or mov) for the transparent overlay variant. The coral field is demo-only and is not part of the style.
